terms.s1Content: By accessing or using Last Peace of Art ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the Platform.

terms.s5List: Post illegal, harassing, threatening, or abusive content | Impersonate any person or entity | Upload viruses, malware, or harmful code | Attempt to access another user's account without permission | Use the Platform for spam, phishing, or unsolicited advertising | Violate any applicable laws or regulations | Interfere with the proper functioning of the Platform | Scrape, crawl, or harvest data without authorization
terms.s6Content: We reserve the right to remove or moderate any content that violates these terms. We may suspend or terminate accounts that repeatedly infringe upon these rules.
terms.s7Content: The Platform's name, logo, design, and code are the property of Last Peace of Art. You may not copy, modify, or distribute them without written permission.
terms.s8Content: The Platform may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content, privacy practices, or terms.
terms.s9Content: The Platform is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service.

terms.s11Content: We may suspend or terminate your account at any time, with or without cause, with or without notice. Upon termination, your right to use the Platform ceases immediately.
terms.s12Content: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the Platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms. We will notify you of material changes via email or platform notice.
terms.s13Content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Egypt.

privacy.s1Content: We collect the following information when you use the Platform:
privacy.s1List: Account Information: name, email address, and profile photo when you register via email or Google OAuth. | Profile Information: bio, skills, avatar, banner, and any other content you add to your profile. | Content: projects, blog posts, forum threads, comments, and any other content you create. | Usage Data: pages visited, time spent, and interactions with the Platform. | Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, and operating system.
privacy.s2List: Provide, maintain, and improve the Platform | Authenticate your identity and secure your account | Display your profile and content to other users | Send you important account-related notifications | Respond to your support requests | Detect and prevent fraudulent or abusive activity | Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience
privacy.s3Content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data only in the following cases:
privacy.s3List: With your explicit consent | With service providers who help operate the Platform (e.g., hosting, analytics) | To comply with legal obligations or respond to lawful requests | To protect the rights, property, or safety of our users or the public
privacy.s4Content: Your data is stored securely on servers provided by Neon (PostgreSQL) and Vercel. We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest. However, no method of electronic storage is 100% secure.
privacy.s5Content: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we will delete your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.
privacy.s6Content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
privacy.s6List: Access the personal data we hold about you | Request correction of inaccurate data | Request deletion of your data | Object to or restrict processing of your data | Data portability | Withdraw consent at any time
privacy.s6Footer: To exercise these rights, contact us at the email below.
privacy.s7Content: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how the Platform is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.s8Content: The Platform uses the following third-party services:
privacy.s8List: Google OAuth: for authentication via Google accounts | Neon: for PostgreSQL database hosting | Vercel: for application hosting and deployment
privacy.s8Footer: Each service has its own privacy policy governing data handling.
privacy.s9Content: The Platform is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that a child under 13 has provided us with personal data, we will delete it.
privacy.s10Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes via email or a notice on the Platform.
privacy.s11Content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your space to create, share, and connect
about.ownerDesc: The creator and owner of Last Peace of Art. A passionate developer and community builder who believes in the power of creation and connection.
about.whatIs: What is Last Peace of Art?
about.whatIsDesc: Last Peace of Art is a creative platform where you can showcase your projects, write blog posts, share your profile, and engage in community discussions. It's a space designed for creators, developers, and artists to express themselves and connect with like-minded people.
about.featureProjects: Showcase your work — Upload and present your projects to the community with rich media galleries, tags, and markdown content.
about.featurePosts: Write about your passions — Share tutorials, thoughts, and stories through our blogging platform.
about.featureForum: Start discussions — Engage with the community, ask questions, and share knowledge in our forum.
about.featureProfile: Build your profile — Create a stunning public profile to display your skills, experience, and personality.
about.featureMessages: Connect with others — Send messages and make friends with other members of the community.
about.howToDesc: Simply create a free account, set up your profile, and start exploring. You can post projects, write articles, join discussions, and connect with other creators right away.
about.missionDesc: To provide a welcoming and inspiring space where creativity meets community. We believe everyone has something valuable to share, and we're here to help you share it with the world.
about.footer: Last Peace of Art — Created with passion.
